people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Joseph returned into Egypt—he, and his brothers, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
translations.bsb: After Joseph had buried his father, he returned to Egypt with his brothers and all who had gone with him to bury his father.
translations.kjv: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
translations.asv: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
